classification.question_topic: Asking if others experience frequent vivid emotionally impactful Mall World dreams with severe sleep disruption/night sweats and difficulty distinguishing dreams from reality
classification.skip_reason: No specific dream scene(s) described; only general/long-term sleep and dream experience without extractable locations, connections, or events.

interactions.description: Dreams occur most nights; are "very vivid and emotionally impactful"; "nonspecific and very night to night"; sometimes "even four different places ventured in a night"; has "visited much of mall world" and describes it as a "very real experience in an alternate reality."
Sleep disruption: "I haven’t had a consistent good night of sleep for five years"; "I wake up constantly".
Somatic/physiological markers on waking: "night sweats"; wakes "freezing"; "waking up nightly, cold and soaking wet".
Attempts to reduce/stop dreams via treatment: "put on so many different SSRIs and PTSD medication, but none have calmed the dreams".
interactions.transaction_blocker: Medications did not reduce dream frequency/intensity ("none have calmed the dreams").

interactions.description: Medical evaluation/plan mentioned: being "trying to put me on a sleep apnea machine"; author reports they "tested so low" and does not believe it matches severity of symptoms.

extraction.extraction_notes: Post contains long-term, generalized Mall World dreaming and strong waking somatic markers (night sweats/freezing) but no describable dream locations, layouts, light qualities, entities, or specific in-dream events to extract as locations/connections.
